name: Poppy Grower
ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
designRole: Prevents evil players learning who each other are until the Poppy Grower dies.
explanation: Prevents evil players learning who each other are until the Poppy Grower dies.

nightInstructions.firstNight: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
nightInstructions.otherNights: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the Minions.

jinxes.reason: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.
If the Poppy Grower is alive on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon but not which player.
If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Widow does not see the Grimoire.
